title: Sandiganbayan enters not guilty plea for ex-Bauan mayor Dolor over graft case

blocks.text: The Sandiganbayan Seventh Division entered a not guilty plea for former Bauan, Batangas Mayor Ryan h Dolor after he refused to enter a plea for his graft charge over the alleged disadvantageous privatization of the Bauan Waterworks System (BWS) to Aquadata Inc. from 2008 to 2013.
